subject: Activation slab & credit wiring for NebulaWorks onboarding
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna@nebulaworks.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@nebulaworks.com
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Initial ask: onboarding assistance + credit application

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was very impressed with the latency numbers. We're onboarding a 6‑person pilot cohort for our product and the accelerator that funds our cohort requires confirmation that vendor credits are in place before cohort kickoff.

Two quick asks: can Redwood provide a $15k promotional allowance that applies at activation (first invoice) and is valid for 6 months from activation? Also, we have a short SOW (attached) that the accelerator wants attached to the vendor credit confirmation.

We're flexible on how the credit shows up on the invoice (promo line / negative line item is fine). Let me know what you need from our side — happy to share incorporation docs or the accelerator acceptance letter.

Best,
Anna Morales
Head of Growth, NebulaWorks
(attachment: Nebula_SOW_v2.pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Morales <anna@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial ask: onboarding assistance + credit application

Anna — really appreciate the clear ask and the SOW. Looping in Kim (billing & credits) and Marcus (partnerships) to scope the quickest path.

Short answers up front:
- We can allocate a $15,000 promo allowance applied as a single line-item credit on the first paid invoice after activation.
- Standard expiry is 90 days; for accelerator deals we can extend to 180 days if we capture a short milestone/usage clause in the SOW (e.g., "activation = first production request / first 100k tokens").
- We will need the accelerator acceptance letter and one of: incorporation date or a recent cap table snapshot to verify program eligibility.

Kim — can you confirm internal packaging (promo code vs invoice credit) and whether we need a PO or signed SOW to wire the credit? Marcus — heads up: NebulaWorks is part of the Crescent Accelerator cohort per the SOW.

Anna — if you prefer, we can send a DocuSign that formalizes the credit + milestone and attaches the SOW.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: NebulaWorks credit eligibility & proposed approval

Vanessa / Marcus — I reviewed NebulaWorks' SOW and the accelerator ask. Per our accelerator credit policy (internal memo v2.3):
- Eligibility: <5 years old OR pre‑seed/seed, ARR < $1M; exceptions allowed for vetted accelerator cohorts.
- Required docs for promo activation: SOW + accelerator acceptance letter + billing contact + legal signoff when >$10k.

Proposal: approve a $15,000 activation slab with 180‑day expiry, conditioned on a short milestone in DocuSign (suggest: first 100k tokens OR 90 days after activation, whichever comes first). Mark as promo line on the invoice (GL code: PROMO‑ACCEL).

I will prepare an approvals packet (credits_approval_form.pdf) and route for manager signoff today. Once signed, billing will create the promo code / invoice line and attach to deal DW-2027-089.

Notes: if Nebula requests the credit be split across multiple invoices, we'll need a PO and finance approval.

-Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
(attachment: credits_approval_form.pdf)

From: Anna Morales <anna@nebulaworks.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@nebulaworks.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation slab & credit wiring for NebulaWorks onboarding

Thanks — Kim, this sounds good. A couple follow ups from our ops team:

1) Can the credit be applied to hosted usage only (we may move to Dedicated later)? We just need it to cover early prod traffic.
2) Who signs the DocuSign — our legal or can your billing team sign a credit addendum?
3) Any chance we can get the credit to show as "NebulaWorks Accelerator Promo" on the invoice for our accounting team?

We're ready to send the accelerator acceptance letter and an incorporation extract — attaching both to this reply.

Anna
(attachment: accelerator_acceptance_letter.pdf)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Morales <anna@nebulaworks.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 17:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation slab & credit wiring for NebulaWorks onboarding

Anna — good news: approvals signed. Final checklist and next steps below.

What we approved:
- $15,000 promo activation slab, applied as a negative line-item on the first post‑activation invoice.
- Valid for 180 days from invoice date (activation defined as first billed production request or first 100k tokens).
- Applies to Hosted usage only; will not auto-apply to Dedicated unless you request a transfer and we re‑authorize with finance.
- Invoice label will read: "NebulaWorks Accelerator Promo (Deal DW-2027-089)".

What we need from you to finalize:
1) Sign the credit addendum via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/REDWOOD-NEBULA-ACTIVATION-2027
2) Confirm billing contact and PO (optional) — send to billing@redwood.ai.
3) Reply to this thread with the accelerator acceptance letter (attached) — already received, thanks.

Attachments included: credits_approval_form.pdf; Nebula_SOW_v2.pdf
HubSpot record: https://hubspot.redwood/deal/DW-2027-089

Once the DocuSign is complete I'll ask billing to attach the promo to your account and confirm the invoice preview. Expect the DocuSign + invoice preview within 48 hours.

Welcome aboard — excited to get NebulaWorks live.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
(attachments: credits_approval_form.pdf, Nebula_SOW_v2.pdf)
